title: Avatar data contracts (params + consent) + validator
summary: The non-biometric data contracts the avatar system is built on: data/schemas/avatar/avatar_params (cosmetic parameter set on the shared rig; no biometric data) + consent_record (layered opt-in), with a reference validator (validate_avatar) + forbidden-key privacy guard + tests. The on-device C# runtime mirrors the validator.

acceptance_tests.test: avatar_params + consent_record schemas are valid JSON Schema, closed, non-biometric (no media/landmark/template fields), with valid/invalid fixtures and the forbidden-key guard; tests green.

history.event: built + merged under AUTH #044: data/schemas/avatar (schemas + validate_avatar + 7 tests + fixtures). AT-1 met. in-progress: the C# mirror + SPEC/DESIGN_SYSTEM reconcile remain.

notes: Non-biometric by construction. The C# runtime (M1-AVAT-02) mirrors validate_avatar.forbidden_keys.
